description: Sets up the signed-in person's MONS account, as the app's onboarding would. Pass the challenge and answers from check_readiness when there are some. Does nothing to an account already set up.

answers.description: The check_readiness answers for challenge_id, if any.

challenge_id.description: Optional: a challenge id from the challenges find_next_challenge lists, when the person names a goal of their own. Omit to let their training answers pick one.

date_of_birth.description: YYYY-MM-DD. MONS is for ages 16 to 80.

kettlebells.description: How many kettlebells they own in each weight class, 0 to 2 each. Moderate: get-ups and overhead work. Heavy: swings, squats and presses. Extra heavy: heavy carries. All 0 trains with bodyweight.

mix.description: How they want to build endurance: runner, swimmer, rider, rider_runner, swimrunner, rider_swimmer or triathlete.

today.description: The person's local date as YYYY-MM-DD, the day before if it is earlier than 05:00 where they are. Omit if unknown.

name: sign_up
title: Set up a MONS account
